posts: "Trust me" isn't a security model. When an agent's reasoning runs inside a TEE, every inference gets a cryptographic receipt — auditable without trusting the operator. That's the shift #agents need, not another promise. #tee

The interesting question for #nearai isn't capability, it's provenance: which model produced this output, under what attestation, on what hardware? Agents that can answer that are the ones people will actually delegate to.
